notes: Adds the first reactor-local timer/deadline queue. Reactor-created channels share a timer queue, timeout wait protocols carry absolute nanosecond deadlines, Reactor::advance_time_to(now_ns) wakes expired deadlines, and wait_event can now return TimedOut while preserving re-observation after spurious event wakes. Tests cover no early timeout, ready-before-timeout timer unregister, and spurious wake re-park before timeout. Scheduler policy and real trap/timer interrupt delivery remain later work; subagent scouts confirmed the safe next boundary is a scheduler shell plus a narrow trap-to-kernel hook after the saved-register trap shell exists.
